paragraphs.text: The college offers three evening courses this autumn. Business English runs on Mondays and Wednesdays and ends with an exam that leads to a recognised certificate.

Digital Photography meets on Tuesday evenings. Students need their own camera, but the college lends laptops for editing photos. There is no exam; instead, students put together a small exhibition at the end of the course.
Introduction to Accounting runs on Thursdays. It is designed for people who run small businesses, and the fee includes a year’s licence for accounting software.

All three courses cost £180, but students who are unemployed pay half. Business English and Accounting also offer online sessions for students who miss a class, and all three courses finish before the winter holiday.
Places are limited to fifteen students on each course. To enrol, complete the form on the college website or visit the reception desk in the main building on any weekday.
